import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int countAsterisks(String s){boolean outside=true;int count=0;for(char c:s.toCharArray()){if(c=='|')outside=!outside;else if(c=='*'&&outside)count++;}return count;} }

title: Best Poker Hand
notes:
Task: Solve Best Poker Hand.
Idea: Classify a five-card hand as Flush, Three of a Kind, Pair, or High Card.
Invariant: Flush has priority; otherwise rank frequency determines the strongest remaining category.
Edge cases: Locally tested with the published example and additional boundary cases.
code:
from collections import Counter
class Solution:
 def bestHand(self, ranks, suits):
  if len(set(suits))==1: return 'Flush'
  c=max(Counter(ranks).values())
  if c>=3: return 'Three of a Kind'
  if c==2: return 'Pair'
  return 'High Card'
complexity_reason: Flush has priority; otherwise rank frequency determines the strongest remaining category.
